raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PAK-ResilientAccessibleMicrofinance",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Recurrent extreme flooding events may cause catastrophic losses across the microfinance sector that exceed the capacity of the Climate Risk Fund.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Transfer extreme flood disaster risk outside the country using an international parametric insurance backstop to top up CRF capital.",
      "evidence": "increased flood events, especially the catastrophic 2022 floods, have led to a structural shift in the sector"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Microfinance providers may continuously disintermediate from rural and agricultural sectors due to perceived heightened climate vulnerability.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy pre-disaster Innovative Agricultural Liquidity (IAL) bundled with agricultural technology advisory services to enhance farm-level resilience.",
      "evidence": "The share of agriculture in total lending of MFBs has declined from 34 percent in FY19 to 28 percent in FY24."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Post-disaster non-performing loan spikes and provisioning expenses can severely erode microfinance bank capital below regulatory minimums.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Provide Contingent Liquidity Facility (CLF) loans post-event allowing microfinance banks to restructure existing loans and issue recovery loans.",
      "evidence": "capital adequacy declined from 14.9 percent to 11.7 percent, against a regulatory minimum of 15 percent."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Commercial financial institutions may de-risk and freeze wholesale funding to non-bank microfinance companies following disaster shocks.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Offer dedicated post-disaster liquidity directly from the CRF to eligible NBMFCs operating in flood-affected districts.",
      "evidence": "NBMFCs... did face serious liquidity constraints... stemming from the financial sector at large derisking from the microfinance sector"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Microfinance market growth may distort toward unproductive, short-term nano loans for consumption rather than productive microenterprise finance.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Earmark CRF pre-disaster liquidity exclusively for bundled, productive climate-smart agricultural loan products.",
      "evidence": "Nano loans have grown by 342 percent over the past five years, in contrast to a 17 percent growth in... conventional microfinance"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Fluctuations in international reinsurance markets or insufficient CRF investment yield could make parametric insurance premiums unaffordable.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct annual reviews of insurance options and CRF financial position through the Oversight Committee while utilizing GSFF grant funding.",
      "evidence": "decision to secure parametric insurance for the CRF will be undertaken by the CRF Oversight Committee on an annual basis"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Parametric triggers or government disaster declarations may fail to activate contingency liquidity during localized floods affecting specific provider portfolios.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish dual activation triggers allowing CRF deployment via government declaration or predefined portfolio loss thresholds of individual MFPs.",
      "evidence": "If the government does not declare an emergency... but a predetermined threshold of the portfolio of a particular MFP is impacted"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Delays in national budget allocations for local currency funding could stall loan disbursements under Category 2 of the project.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Ensure timely coordination between Ministry of Finance and State Bank of Pakistan to incorporate required allocations in the national budget.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawals can take place under Category 2 until the Recipient has ensured... requested in its budget allocation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Delay in legal execution and registration of the Trust Deed between Ministry of Finance and SBP could delay project effectiveness.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Finalize acceptable standard Trust Deed terms and registration requirements as a prerequisite condition for effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "The Trust Deed... has been executed between the Recipient... and State Bank of Pakistan and registered"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R010",
      "description": "Microfinance providers may fail to meet the required 55 percent allocation of recovery loans to female borrowers due to mobility and structural constraints.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Charge higher borrowing costs to MFPs that deviate from agreed female allocations and conduct loan officer gender bias awareness training.",
      "evidence": "MFPs will be required to pay a higher borrowing cost to the CRF in instances there is deviation from the agreed allocation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Clustering of agritech loans in specific regions may cause cumulative environmental impacts through increased pesticide and fertilizer usage.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply SBP's Environmental and Social Management System and enforce ESCP operational guidelines across all participating microfinance providers.",
      "evidence": "interventions may increase use of fertilizers, pesticides and other chemicals."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Macroeconomic instability and rising market benchmark interest rates (KIBOR) could increase borrowing costs and reduce loan affordability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Structure CRF pass-through rates around standardized market terms while providing interest rate concessions for vulnerable target groups.",
      "evidence": "Market terms here in the context of lending from the CRF to MFPs refers to the 6-month Karachi Interbank Offer Rate (KIBOR)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Selected Agricultural Technology Companies may lack capacity or fail to deliver effective farm-level yield and resilience improvements.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Select ATCs through a competitive Agriculture Finance Innovation Challenge (AFIC) with strict eligibility and technical criteria.",
      "evidence": "A panel of ATCs will be selected to provide agritech services in partnership with MFPs through an Agriculture Finance Innovation Challenge"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Operational and governance friction may arise from the State Bank of Pakistan acting concurrently as regulator and project Trustee.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Ring-fence public assets within an autonomous Trust structure and separate strategic oversight from daily operations via dual committees.",
      "evidence": "Trust modality has been informed by lessons learned... wherein a Trust structure was used to ring fence public sector assets"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Overlapping or competing liquidity interventions between World Bank and ADB support programs could cause market confusion or distortion.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain joint implementation coordination mechanisms and ensure clear market segmentation between World Bank and ADB facilities.",
      "evidence": "developed such that there is clear market segmentation so that the proposed WBG guarantee structure compliments... ADB"
    }
  ]
}
